title: QuantityLimit
description: A typical maximum number of units for a billing code, with a source and year. Used by /core to flag quantities that may be worth asking about. Produced outside /core (the data pipeline); /core never invents a limit.

code.description: Billing code this limit applies to.

code_system.description: Which coding system `code` belongs to. Set it whenever known.

max_units.description: Typical maximum units for one line. Must be greater than zero.

data_source.description: Where this limit came from. Required and non-empty.

data_year.description: Year the limit is from. Required.
